yt-kissa.topic: Ep 16: Vikram's spy plants a hidden camera in Riya's room, and Kabir catches it, so they must stage a loving night to fool the spy, which accidentally makes them feel real warmth
yt-kissa.why: Brings in the spy plotline from the premise and breaks the 'no feelings' rule for the first time in a funny, romantic way.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 17: Kabir finds the unsent envelope of loan-waiver papers in Kavita's trunk and learns Ramesh's debt was never real, so Vikram forged it, but Kavita vanishes before they can ask who gave it to her
yt-kissa.why: Delivers the first solid proof that ties Ramesh's debt to Vikram's scheme, ends the first act of the Meera mystery on a cliffhanger, and pushes Kabir to trust Riya fully.
